title: Defense to ICC: Rodrigo Duterte suffering ‘significant memory impairment’

blocks.text: THE HAGUE, Netherlands — Former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte is suffering from significant memory loss, occasionally forgetting his lawyer’s name, according to the defense team preparing his case at the International Criminal Court (ICC). Duterte, 81, faces charges of crimes against humanity over the thousands of killings recorded during his deadly war on drugs, prosecutors said. His trial is scheduled to start on Nov. 30, but judges are weighing whether he is mentally fit to be tried and ordered a medical assessment by three experts.
